reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking diffusion-driven coarsening of Mg-rich intermetallics to divergent effects on oxidation (enhanced MgO scale) and corrosion (disrupted passivation), which aligns with known behavior of Mg and Al in alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on correlating microstructural evolution (coarsening/segregation) with measured oxidation and corrosion outcomes.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the underexplored evolution-corrosion-oxidation nexus in Mg-containing lightweight HEAs, providing a testable mechanism that would advance understanding of property trade-offs.
